basic_info.description: Modern Home with Panoramic Views and Contemporary Elegance! Perched on a quiet block and privately situated, this beautifully renovated modern home offers breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean, Olympic Golf Course, San Bruno Mountains, South Hills, and the Minnie & Lovie Ward Recreation Center. Thoughtfully updated with today's modern amenities, the home features 4 spacious bedrooms and 3 luxurious bathrooms. The expansive living room, kitchen, and dining area are designed for both comfort and style, with large windows framing stunning vistas and filling the space with natural light. The open-concept layout flows effortlessly into a deep, modern backyard with multiple terraced levels, perfect for entertaining, gardening, or relaxing in privacy. Bright and airy throughout, the home also boasts multiple indoor and outdoor entertainment areas, offering versatility for both intimate gatherings and larger celebrations.    Conveniently located near BART, MUNI, freeways, parks, schools, H Mart, and other shops, this home combines serene living with unbeatable access to urban amenities.
